title: Answer the six proof questions
purpose: Six short answers that decide what the profile may claim and what to build next.
why: Only claim what you can explain or show. Each answer decides what the profile may say, and each "no" becomes something to build.

modules.title: Help the right people see your work

tasks.title: Agent systems: an LLM/agent that calls tools, uses structured output, keeps state, or does multi-step work?
AI reliability: evals, tracing, guardrails, retries, fallbacks, approval steps, monitoring?
Python/backend: FastAPI, SQL/Postgres, external APIs, Docker, AWS: which parts are strongest?
Customer ownership: mapped a messy workflow, scoped it, owned delivery? Best example?
AI-native workflow: which tools do you actively use (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, MCP, n8n)? What have you automated?
Proof and initiative: the hardest thing you can show a founder now (repo, demo, architecture, metrics)?
tasks.done_when: Answered in 1–3 lines, or "none strong yet".
